default.notes: Not on the visa-waiver list — apply for the Hayya A1 tourist visa online before travel; approval may require confirmed accommodation and can involve additional checks.

groups.notes: GCC citizens may enter Qatar freely under Gulf Cooperation Council arrangements — a national ID card is accepted and no visa is needed.
Free visa waiver on arrival — up to 90 days within any 180-day period, on the terms applied to EU and Schengen-area passports.
Free visa waiver issued on arrival for 30 days, extendable once for a further 30 days.

QA.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Qatari citizens.

IL.notes: Qatar does not routinely admit Israeli passport holders for tourism — entry generally requires prior authorisation from the Qatari authorities, as has been arranged for special events.
